g.aria-label: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO): Inverting the Tilted Optimum
1. Solve tilted optimum π*(y|x) = π_ref(y|x) e^{r/β} / Z(x) for r(x, y):
r(x, y) = β log [ π*(y | x) / π_ref(y | x) ] + β log Z(x)
2. Substitute into Bradley–Terry r(x, y_w) − r(x, y_l) (Z(x) cancels!):
3. Optimize policy π_θ directly by binary cross-entropy on (y_w ≻ y_l):
L_DPO(θ) = −E_D[ log σ( β log(π_θ(y_w)/π_ref(y_w)) − β log(π_θ(y_l)/π_ref(y_l)) ) ]
